1.title: Introduction to HTML
1.explanation: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the standard language used to build web pages. It defines the structure of a webpage using elements called tags.
1.code:
Hello World

This is my first HTML page.
1.output: A webpage displaying the heading 'Hello World' and a paragraph below it.
1.practice: Create a webpage with your name as a heading and your country in a paragraph.

2.title: HTML Elements
2.explanation: HTML elements include headings, paragraphs, images, links, lists, tables, forms, and many others.
2.output: A heading, a paragraph, and a clickable link.
2.practice: Create a page containing one heading, two paragraphs, and one link.
2.quiz: Which HTML tag creates a hyperlink?
